method_steps.branching_iteration_or_rework: Because corrected inertia alone did not explain the unrealistic response, the team next measured the mu-metal amplification factor.

method_steps.action: Tune Kane-damper Id and c with a nested-loop confining search that repeatedly narrows the best region.
material_inputs: Initial Id and c search region
outputs: Selected Id and c parameters and simulated convergence time
tools_and_settings: Reported m value is internally inconsistent (10% in Figure 45, 20% in prose)
method_steps.automation: Nested loops execute the search; a popup asks the operator how to handle an edge optimum.
method_steps.decision_rules: Minimize the latest settling index across all three angular velocities; zoom around an interior optimum, or choose whether to expand when the optimum lies on a boundary.
method_steps.quality_or_exit_checks: Require n consecutive values and the endpoint within the convergence band; confirm the resulting 21 min convergence meets requirement 2.1.
method_steps.branching_iteration_or_rework: Continue zooming until required accuracy; at a border, either expand autonomously or retain and refine the original boundary.

method_steps.action: Construct and combine hard-iron, PWM-dependent soft-iron, battery-voltage, and temperature correction models for the IMU magnetometer.
responsible_roles: Operator for calibration and data reduction
method_steps.automation: Scripts collect samples and fit polynomials; data transfer, averaging, and calibration manipulation include manual steps.
method_steps.decision_rules: Select polynomial order by diminishing RMS-error returns, use third-degree fits, and scale PWM fits with a battery-voltage correlation coefficient.
method_steps.quality_or_exit_checks: Compare model predictions with random-PWM IMU measurements and compare temperature-model values with experimental values.
method_steps.branching_iteration_or_rework: Repeat measurements by coil, coordinate axis, voltage, and temperature direction; select the increasing-temperature dataset after hysteresis review.

method_steps.action: Translate the tuned controller into a C++ library for the Teensy flight computer and compare runtime outputs with MATLAB/Simulink.
outputs: Integrated Teensy ACS control library and selected 0.01 s refresh rate
method_steps.automation: Both model and embedded controller execute automatically.
method_steps.decision_rules: Select a timestep that is safe while the Teensy also runs the test plant simulation.
method_steps.quality_or_exit_checks: Compare runtime, speed, and accuracy plots and repeat the steady-value run three times.
method_steps.branching_iteration_or_rework: Different timesteps are tested before selecting 0.01 s.
